title: ‘Always Yours, Never Mine’ hits P100 million in earnings
summary: Julia Barretto and Joshua Garcia-led film “Always Yours, Never Mine” has surpassed the P100 million mark in total gross, about two weeks after it premiered in local cinemas. The milestone…

blocks.text: Julia Barretto and Joshua Garcia-led film “Always Yours, Never Mine” has surpassed the P100 million mark in total gross, about two weeks after it premiered in local cinemas. The milestone was announced by Star Cinema on its social media pages on Sunday, Oct. 11, thanking fans for supporting the movie. “Thank you for loving Apollo and Luna’s story,” it said, referring to Garcia and Barretto’s respective characters. Also celebrating the feat was Julia’s mom, Marjorie Barretto, who congratulated the pair through the comments section.
